acceptance: Parity job runs on every PR touching docs/ or website/ (non-required)
Report: zero unexplained differences; allow-list entries each have a reason and approval
Redirect-page count reported against the 5% abandon threshold
description:
Add a non-required CI job that assembles both sites from the same develop SHA and runs `site_inventory diff` (astro-site-01) on them.

It checks:
- missing paths
- lost anchors
- changed titles and headings
- broken internal links
- missing images
- tag pages, archives and series
- atom.xml entry ids
- generated query pages
- the API URL map

It also runs axe over every page template, the docs/blog Explorer-byte check, check_artifact_privacy.py, and the Pagefind smoke search.

Every remaining difference must be in an allow-list. Each allow-list entry carries a reason and an owner approval. Redirect pages count toward the ADR abandon threshold.

Gate: the owner signs off the parity report before astro-site-53 may start.
